ns2:course.label: Electromagnetic Fields I
ns2:course.description: Static electric and magnetic fields, their interactions with electric charge and current, and their transformation properties; the effect of special relativity is incorporated. Macroscopic fields in material media are described. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: MATH 285; credit or concurrent enrollment in PHYS 325.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: MATH 285; credit or concurrent enrollment in PHYS 325.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Register for the lecture and one of the discussion sections.
